scripts.standalone:assets: sh -c 'if [ -d .next/standalone/apps/www ]; then rm -rf .next/standalone/apps/www/public .next/standalone/apps/www/.next/static && mkdir -p .next/standalone/apps/www/.next && cp -R public .next/standalone/apps/www/public && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/apps/www/.next/static; fi'
scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ -f .next/standalone/apps/www/server.js ]; then cd .next/standalone && node apps/www/server.js; elif [ -f .next/standalone/server.js ]; then cd .next/standalone && node server.js; else next start -p ${PORT:-3000}; fi'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
